scope: Additive TH18 Home Village Super Wizard Chain Magic delta; preserves each preceding frozen reference.
game_version: The immutable payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. Public sources do not identify a target client build, which remains unknown.

sources.title: Balance Changes Now Live
sources.limitations: The official note fixes secondary chain damage at 40%, but does not publish radius, cap, eligibility, timing or current build.

sources.title: Changes coming to Ranked Mode & League Modifiers!
sources.limitations: The note records damage and hitpoint buffs, not Chain Magic geometry or timing.

sources.title: The December 2020 update is live
sources.limitations: Describes up to ten chains within the original target range, without a current build or exact selection/timing contract.

sources.title: Super Wizard | Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.limitations: Describes ten total victims (primary plus nine branches) at 40% secondary damage, but no versioned radius or timing contract.

official_deltas.behavior: Secondary Chain Magic damage is 40% of primary damage.

chain_target_count.note: Secondary interpretation is ten total victims: primary plus at most nine branches; Clash Ninja's 'up to 10 times' wording is retained as an uncertainty.

chain_radius_tiles.note: Documented approximation: the source says branches remain within the original target range but gives no measured radius. Core uses the immutable three-tile base attack range as the proxy; replace on a versioned radius contract.

support.note: Core branches from a captured primary target, orders secondary victims by distance then entity ID, and uses its serialised T+10-ms projectile path. Cap/radius/eligibility/flight are documented approximations or uncertainties.

changed_values.previous_state: catalogued-only because Chain Magic geometry was incomplete
changed_values.replacement: primary 40% branches with a clearly marked ten-total-victim and base-range proxy implementation
changed_values.justification: The lenient integration goal permits transparent, evidence-backed deterministic approximations where full public contracts are unavailable.

known_uncertainties: Public sources disagree or are ambiguous about ten total victims versus ten secondary bounces.
No current versioned chain radius, eligibility, order, projectile travel, target-loss, collision, spell interaction or visual contract was found.
Core's ten-total cap, three-tile proxy, distance/ID order and T+10-ms projectiles are replaceable deterministic approximations and are not game-exact claims.
conclusion: This versioned delta enables broad shared-adapter Chain Magic coverage while retaining every unsupported behavior as an explicit uncertainty.
